mapper.insert: INSERT INTO child (member_id, name, birth_date, gender, disorder_type, severity, character_type, character_nickname, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{disorderType}, #{severity}, #{characterType}, #{characterNickname}, NOW())

INSERT INTO checklist (child_id, domain, question_no, score, created_at) VALUES
(#{a.childId}, #{a.domain}, #{a.questionNo}, #{a.score}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT checklist_id , child_id , domain , question_no , score FROM checklist WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY checklist_id
